title: The hair growth cycle

stages.label: Resting
stages.note: Telogen: a few months of rest

explain.say: Each hair grows from a tiny pocket in your skin called a follicle. Every follicle runs its own cycle of growing, pausing, resting and shedding.

stages.label: Resting
stages.note: Telogen: a few months of rest

explain.say: In the growing phase, cells at the base of the follicle divide fast. They fill with a tough protein called keratin and die, pushing up the hair shaft. On the scalp this phase lasts years.

stages.label: Resting
stages.note: Telogen: a few months of rest

explain.say: Then the follicle shrinks and stops growing for a few weeks, followed by a resting phase of a few months. The old hair stays in place but is no longer attached to the growing cells.

stages.label: Resting
stages.note: Telogen: a few months of rest

explain.say: Finally the old hair is shed as a new hair starts growing beneath it. Because each follicle is at a different stage, you lose about 50 to 100 scalp hairs a day without going bald.

stages.label: Resting
stages.note: Telogen: a few months of rest

faq.a: Cells at the root of the follicle divide, fill with keratin and are pushed upward, forming the hair shaft. The hair you see is made of dead cells; only the root is alive.
asks: Tell me about the growing phase

faq.a: Scalp hair grows about 1 centimetre a month, or roughly 15 centimetres a year.
asks: How many centimetres does hair grow a year?

faq.a: Each hair falls out at the end of its cycle, when a new hair starts growing in the same follicle. Losing around 50 to 100 scalp hairs a day is normal.
asks: Is losing hair every day normal?

faq.a: Eyebrow follicles have a short growing phase, only a few months, so the hairs fall out before they get long. Scalp follicles grow for years.
asks: Why doesn't body hair grow as long as head hair?

faq.q: Does cutting hair make it grow faster?
faq.a: No. Hair grows from the root under the skin, so cutting the dead ends does not change the growth rate.

facts: Scalp hair grows about 1 centimetre a month.
The growing phase of a scalp hair usually lasts 2 to 7 years.
People typically shed about 50 to 100 scalp hairs a day.

quiz.say: Why don't we go bald from shedding hairs every day?
quiz.show: Why don't we go bald from shedding hairs every day?
